芝诺之后的斯多葛学派领袖，以《宙斯赞歌》和顺从宇宙理性的虔敬伦理著称。
oneLineEn: Stoic leader after Zeno, known for the Hymn to Zeus and a piety of assent to cosmic reason.

oneLineZh: 系统化早期斯多葛逻辑、物理学和伦理学，使斯多葛主义成为严整哲学体系。
oneLineEn: Systematized early Stoic logic, physics, and ethics into a rigorous philosophical architecture.

oneLineZh: 犬儒学派代表人物，用贫穷、自足和公开挑衅把哲学变成生活批判。
oneLineEn: Cynic who made philosophy a life-critique through poverty, self-sufficiency, and public provocation.

oneLineZh: 苏格拉底弟子之一，强调德性、自足和艰苦训练，被视为犬儒传统的重要先驱。
oneLineEn: Socratic disciple stressing virtue, self-sufficiency, and hard training; key forerunner of Cynicism.

oneLineZh: 毕达哥拉斯传统把数、宇宙秩序、灵魂净化和共同体生活连接起来。
oneLineEn: The Pythagorean tradition linked number, cosmic order, soul purification, and communal life.

oneLineZh: 米利都学派代表人物，以 apeiron、宇宙生成和自然化解释推进早期希腊哲学。
oneLineEn: Milesian thinker who advanced early Greek philosophy via the apeiron, cosmogenesis, and naturalistic explanation.

oneLineZh: 米利都学派哲人，以气、凝聚和稀薄化解释自然变化与宇宙结构。
oneLineEn: Milesian philosopher explaining natural change and cosmic structure via air, condensation, and rarefaction.

oneLineZh: 前苏格拉底诗哲，批判拟人神观，并提出关于神、自然和人类知识限度的早期反思。
oneLineEn: Presocratic poet-philosopher who criticized anthropomorphic gods and probed limits of human knowledge.

oneLineZh: 以四根、爱与争斗、宇宙循环和灵魂净化综合自然哲学与宗教伦理。
oneLineEn: Joined four roots, Love and Strife, cosmic cycles, and soul purification into natural philosophy and religious ethics.

oneLineZh: 把无限种子、万物相含和 Nous 引入自然哲学，并把爱奥尼亚自然解释带入雅典。
oneLineEn: Brought infinite seeds, mutual containment, and Nous into natural philosophy, carrying Ionian science into Athens.

oneLineZh: 爱利亚学派哲人，以反多和反运动悖论捍卫巴门尼德式存在论。
oneLineEn: Eleatic thinker defending Parmenidean ontology with paradoxes against plurality and motion.

oneLineZh: 古代原子论代表人物，以原子与虚空解释自然，并提出感知、约定和安宁伦理问题。
oneLineEn: Ancient atomist explaining nature by atoms and void; raised issues of perception, convention, and ethical calm.

oneLineZh: 智者运动代表人物，以“人是万物尺度”、德性教育和城邦实践理性著称。
oneLineEn: Leading sophist known for man as measure, virtue education, and civic practical reason.

oneLineZh: 智者和修辞家，以激进的存在论论证、语言力量和说服技艺闻名。
oneLineEn: Sophist and rhetorician famed for radical ontological arguments, linguistic power, and the art of persuasion.

oneLineZh: 皮浪主义源头人物，以悬置判断和心灵安宁的传统影响古代怀疑论。
oneLineEn: Founding figure of Pyrrhonism; suspension of judgment and mental calm shaped ancient skepticism.

oneLineZh: 亚里士多德继承者，扩展逍遥学派自然研究、植物学、性格描写和学术制度。
oneLineEn: Aristotle's successor expanding Peripatetic natural study, botany, character writing, and scholarly institutions.

oneLineZh: 新学园怀疑主义代表，以反斯多葛知识论、概率性判断和罗马正义演说闻名。
oneLineEn: New Academy skeptic known for anti-Stoic epistemology, probable judgment, and Roman speeches on justice.

oneLineZh: 罗马政治家和哲学作者，把希腊哲学翻译进拉丁公共理性、共和伦理和自然法传统。
oneLineEn: Roman statesman-author who rendered Greek philosophy into Latin public reason, republican ethics, and natural law.

oneLineZh: 罗马伊壁鸠鲁主义诗人，以《物性论》用原子论治疗宗教恐惧和死亡恐惧。
oneLineEn: Roman Epicurean poet who, in De Rerum Natura, uses atomism to cure fear of the gods and of death.

oneLineZh: 罗马斯多葛哲人和政治家，以书信、论怒、论仁慈和有限生命训练展开实践伦理。
oneLineEn: Roman Stoic statesman developing practical ethics in letters and essays on anger, clemency, and finite life.

oneLineZh: 罗马斯多葛教师，以控制二分、同意训练和内在自由构成最具实践性的斯多葛手册传统。
oneLineEn: Roman Stoic teacher whose control dichotomy, assent training, and inner freedom define a practical handbook tradition.

oneLineZh: 罗马皇帝和斯多葛作者，以《沉思录》把宇宙秩序、职责和自我训练结合起来。
oneLineEn: Roman emperor and Stoic author who, in the Meditations, joins cosmic order, duty, and self-discipline.

oneLineZh: 以知识学把康德批判哲学推进为从自我活动出发的自由体系。
oneLineEn: Advanced Kant's critical philosophy into a freedom system grounded in self-activity (Wissenschaftslehre).

oneLineZh: 把自然、精神、艺术和自由组织为德国观念论内部最具生成性的体系实验。
oneLineEn: Organized nature, spirit, art, and freedom into German Idealism's most generative systematic experiments.

oneLineZh: 把黑格尔思辨神学倒转为人本学宗教批判，并成为马克思早期异化批判的近端入口。
oneLineEn: Inverted Hegelian theology into humanist critique of religion; a near gateway for Marx's early alienation critique.

oneLineZh: 以人的脆弱、理性的限度和信仰赌注重塑早期现代基督教护教与存在论感受。
oneLineEn: Reshaped early modern Christian apologetics through human fragility, reason's limits, and the wager.

oneLineZh: 以探究逻辑、实用主义准则和三元符号学奠定美国实用主义的科学形态。
oneLineEn: Founded scientific American pragmatism through inquiry logic, the pragmatic maxim, and triadic semiotics.

oneLineZh: 把心理学、宗教经验、自由意志和实用主义真理观连接成经验多元论。
oneLineEn: Linked psychology, religious experience, free will, and pragmatic truth into radical empiricist pluralism.

oneLineZh: 以双重意识、色线和废奴民主把种族经验推进为现代政治哲学和社会科学问题。
oneLineEn: Advanced racial experience as modern political philosophy via double consciousness, color line, and abolition democracy.

oneLineZh: 以伦理非自然主义、反观念论和常识实在论推动剑桥分析哲学成形。
oneLineEn: Helped form Cambridge analytic philosophy via ethical non-naturalism, anti-idealism, and common-sense realism.

oneLineZh: 以可证伪性、批判理性主义和开放社会论重塑二十世纪科学哲学与政治哲学。
oneLineEn: Remade 20th-c. philosophy of science and politics through falsifiability, critical rationalism, and the open society.

oneLineZh: 以范式、常规科学和科学革命改写科学进步的历史哲学图景。
oneLineEn: Rewrote historical philosophy of scientific progress via paradigms, normal science, and scientific revolutions.

oneLineZh: 以精神科学、体验和理解理论把历史生命世界纳入哲学方法论。
oneLineEn: Brought the historical life-world into method via Geisteswissenschaften, Erlebnis, and Verstehen.

oneLineZh: 以效果历史、视域融合和语言性把解释学从方法论扩展为哲学本体论。
oneLineEn: Extended hermeneutics from method to ontology via effective history, fusion of horizons, and linguisticality.

oneLineZh: 以生存哲学、界限处境和轴心时代思想连接克尔凯郭尔、尼采、海德格尔与阿伦特。
oneLineEn: Connected Kierkegaard, Nietzsche, Heidegger, and Arendt through Existenz, limit situations, and the Axial Age.

oneLineZh: 以《皮浪主义纲要》和《反学者》保存古代皮浪主义，并成为近代怀疑论复兴的文本枢纽。
oneLineEn: Preserved ancient Pyrrhonism in the Outlines and Against the Professors, a hub for early modern skeptical revival.

oneLineZh: 以存在单义性、形式区别和个体性理论构成阿奎那与奥卡姆之间的经院哲学关键中环。
oneLineEn: Scholastic link between Aquinas and Ockham via univocity of being, formal distinction, and individuation theory.

oneLineZh: 作为阿拉伯哲学源头人物，把希腊哲学翻译运动、第一哲学和伊斯兰一神论组织到同一项目中。
oneLineEn: Founding figure of Arabic philosophy uniting the Greek translation movement, first philosophy, and Islamic monotheism.

oneLineZh: 以照明哲学把伊本·西那传统、柏拉图主义光形而上学和临现知识改造成伊斯兰哲学新路线。
oneLineEn: Recast Ibn Sina, Platonic light metaphysics, and knowledge by presence into Illuminationist Islamic philosophy.

oneLineZh: 以存在一性、完人、想象和神名理论塑造伊斯兰神秘形而上学，并深刻影响穆拉·萨德拉。
oneLineEn: Shaped Islamic mystical metaphysics via oneness of being, Perfect Human, imagination, and divine names.

oneLineZh: 综合法、术、势与刑名之学，构成战国末期法家政治哲学的系统表达。
oneLineEn: Systematized late Warring States Legalism by uniting law, statecraft, power, and forms-and-names doctrine.

oneLineZh: 以《坛经》中的顿悟、自性、无念和定慧不二塑造中国禅宗南宗经典形象。
oneLineEn: Shaped Southern Chan via sudden enlightenment, self-nature, no-thought, and nondual samadhi-prajna (Platform Sutra).

keywordsEn: all people as siblings, all things as companions
oneLineZh: 以太虚即气、民胞物与和成德工夫奠定北宋道学气本论传统。
oneLineEn: Founded Northern Song qi ontology through Great Void as qi, all people as siblings, and virtue cultivation practice.

oneLineZh: 以《集量论》奠定佛教量论，把有效认知限定为现量与比量，并提出遮诠语言理论。
oneLineEn: Founded Buddhist pramana theory, limiting valid cognition to perception and inference, with apoha semantics.

oneLineZh: 以女性理性教育和公民平等批判启蒙时代的性别秩序。
oneLineEn: Critiqued Enlightenment gender order through women's rational education and civic equality.

oneLineZh: 以意向行动分析和现代道德哲学批判推动德性伦理复兴。
oneLineEn: Helped revive virtue ethics through analysis of intentional action and critique of modern moral philosophy.

oneLineZh: 以《救赎之星》反击总体体系，并开出现代犹太对话哲学路线。
oneLineEn: Countered totalizing systems in The Star of Redemption and opened a modern Jewish dialogical philosophy.

oneLineZh: 以殖民心理分析和民族解放理论连接存在主义与后殖民思想。
oneLineEn: Linked existentialism and postcolonial thought through colonial psychology and theories of national liberation.

oneLineZh: 以对话、意识化和银行式教育批判奠定批判教育学。
oneLineEn: Founded critical pedagogy through dialogue, conscientization, and critique of banking-model education.

oneLineEn: Tang fifth Huayan patriarch and Chan-doctrine mediator joining panjiao with three-teachings comparison.

keywordsEn: Collection on the Common Return of Myriad Goods
oneLineZh: 五代宋初佛教大师，以《宗镜录》综合禅教与万善归心。
oneLineEn: Five Dynasties–Song master who joined Chan teaching with myriad-good return in the Source-Mirror.

keywordsEn: Yuan Dao (On the Origin of the Way)
oneLineZh: 唐代儒家复兴和古文运动代表，以《原道》重申儒家道统。
oneLineEn: Tang Confucian revivalist and Ancient Prose leader who restated the Confucian Way in Yuan Dao.

oneLineZh: 唐代儒者，以《复性书》讨论性情和恢复本性。
oneLineEn: Tang Confucian who, in Book of Returning to Nature, discussed nature, emotion, and recovery of original nature.

oneLineZh: 唐代思想家和文学家，以天人、封建与政治制度论著称。
oneLineEn: Tang thinker-writer known for arguments on Heaven and humanity, fengjian, and political institutions.

keywordsEn: On the Zhouli Bringing Great Peace
oneLineZh: 北宋儒者和制度思想家，以礼制、财政和经世论著称。
oneLineEn: Northern Song Confucian and institutional thinker known for ritual, finance, and statecraft.

oneLineZh: 北宋教育家和儒者，以安定学派、经义治事教育著称。
oneLineEn: Northern Song educator-Confucian known for the Anding school and classics-plus-affairs pedagogy.

oneLineZh: 北宋理学先驱，以象数宇宙论和观物思想著称。
oneLineEn: Northern Song Neo-Confucian pioneer known for image-number cosmology and observing things.

keywordsEn: Comprehensive Mirror for Aid in Government
oneLineZh: 北宋史学家和政治家，以《资治通鉴》与政治秩序论著称。
oneLineEn: Northern Song historian-statesman known for the Comprehensive Mirror and theories of political order.

oneLineZh: 北宋文学家和思想人物，兼通儒释道，以经解、政论和人生论著称。
oneLineEn: Northern Song literatus spanning the Three Teachings; known for classics, statecraft, and life-writing.

oneLineZh: 宋代理学人物，承接程门并影响李侗、朱熹学脉。
oneLineEn: Song Neo-Confucian linking Cheng disciples to Li Tong and Zhu Xi's lineage.

oneLineZh: 南宋湖湘学派代表，以《知言》讨论性体和修养。
oneLineEn: Southern Song Huxiang School figure whose Understanding Words treats nature-substance and cultivation.

oneLineZh: 南宋理学家，湖湘学派代表，与朱熹长期论学。
oneLineEn: Southern Song Neo-Confucian of the Huxiang school who long debated with Zhu Xi.

oneLineZh: 南宋永康学派代表，以事功论和朱熹王霸义利之辨著称。
oneLineEn: Southern Song Yongkang figure known for practical accomplishment and the Wang-Ba / yi-li debate with Zhu Xi.

keywordsEn: Sequential Record of Learning and Words
oneLineZh: 南宋永嘉学派代表，以制度、功利和学术史批评著称。
oneLineEn: Southern Song Yongjia figure known for institutions, utility, and critique in intellectual history.

keywordsEn: Collected Sayings on the Record of Rites
oneLineZh: 元代理学家和经学家，调和朱陆并重整经学。
oneLineEn: Yuan Neo-Confucian classicist reconciling Zhu and Lu and reorganizing classical studies.

keywordsEn: Direct Explanations of the Elementary Learning and Great Learning
oneLineZh: 元初理学家和政治教育人物，推动程朱学进入元代制度。
oneLineEn: Early Yuan Neo-Confucian educator who brought Cheng-Zhu learning into Yuan institutions.

oneLineZh: 明初理学家，以康斋学派和居敬实践影响陈献章。
oneLineEn: Early Ming Neo-Confucian whose Kangzhai school and reverent practice influenced Chen Xianzhang.

oneLineZh: 明代白沙学派创始人，重视心体自得和静坐涵养。
oneLineEn: Founder of the Ming Baisha School, stressing self-attainment of mind-substance and quiet-sitting cultivation.

oneLineZh: 明代理学家，河东学派代表，强调复性和笃实践履。
oneLineEn: Ming Neo-Confucian of the Hedong school stressing return to nature and earnest practice.

keywordsEn: li and qi as one thing
oneLineZh: 明代理学家，以《困知记》讨论理气、心性并批评王学。
oneLineEn: Ming Neo-Confucian; Knowledge Painfully Acquired treats li-qi and mind-nature while criticizing Wang Learning.

oneLineZh: 明代气学思想家，以气一元论和经验取向批评空疏心学。
oneLineEn: Ming qi monist who used experience-oriented qi monism against empty mind learning.

oneLineZh: 明代甘泉学派代表，与王阳明并立而论学。
oneLineEn: Ming Ganquan school leader who taught as a peer and rival of Wang Yangming.

keywordsEn: the Way is the people's daily use
investigating things to settle the self
oneLineZh: 明代泰州学派创始人，以百姓日用即道和格物安身著称。
oneLineEn: Ming Taizhou founder; held that the Way is the people's daily use and sought self-settling via gewu.

oneLineZh: 晚明泰州学派人物，以赤子良心、日用教化和平民讲学著称。
oneLineEn: Late Ming Taizhou figure known for childlike conscience, daily teaching, and popular lecturing.

oneLineZh: 晚明思想家，以童心说、反伪道学和个体真诚著称。
oneLineEn: Late Ming thinker known for the childlike mind, critique of false Dao Learning, and personal sincerity.

oneLineZh: 晚明东林学派代表，重建东林书院并强调士人公共责任。
oneLineEn: Late Ming Donglin leader who rebuilt Donglin Academy and stressed literati public responsibility.

oneLineZh: 晚明东林领袖，兼重静坐工夫与政治名节。
oneLineEn: Late Ming Donglin leader stressing both quiet-sitting cultivation and political integrity.

oneLineZh: 明末大儒，蕺山学派创始人，以慎独和诚意工夫著称。
oneLineEn: Late Ming master and Jishan School founder known for shendu and sincerity cultivation.

oneLineZh: 明清之际思想家和史学家，以君主批判与学术史书写著称。
oneLineEn: Ming-Qing thinker-historian known for critique of monarchy and for Confucian intellectual history writing.

oneLineZh: 明清之际经世考据学者，以《日知录》开清代实学风气。
oneLineEn: Ming-Qing statecraft and evidential scholar; Record of Daily Knowledge opened Qing practical learning.

keywordsEn: Notes on the Principles of Things
empirical measurement and penetrating the subtle
oneLineZh: 明清之际思想家，兼通儒释道与自然知识。
oneLineEn: Ming-Qing thinker bridging Confucianism, Buddhism, Daoism, and natural knowledge.

oneLineZh: 明清之际儒者，以《大学辨》质疑经典权威和理学解释。
oneLineEn: Ming-Qing Confucian who, in Disputing the Great Learning, challenged canonical Neo-Confucian reading.

oneLineZh: 清初思想家，以《潜书》批判君主权力和社会不平。
oneLineEn: Early Qing thinker who, in Hidden Book, criticized monarchical power and social injustice.

oneLineZh: 清初实学代表，主张实文、实行、实用，反对空谈理学。
oneLineEn: Early Qing practical-learning leader urging solid writing, practice, and use against empty Neo-Confucianism.

oneLineZh: 清初颜李学派代表，继承颜元实学和实践教育路线。
oneLineEn: Early Qing Yan-Li school figure continuing Yan Yuan's practical learning and educational practice.

oneLineZh: 清初程朱学者和循吏，以尊朱、讲学和地方治理著称。
oneLineEn: Early Qing Cheng-Zhu scholar-official known for honoring Zhu Xi, lecturing, and local governance.

oneLineZh: 清初经学家，以博辨考据和反朱子《四书》解释著称。
oneLineEn: Early Qing classicist known for broad evidential debate and anti-Zhu readings of the Four Books.

keywordsEn: General Meaning of Literature and History
the Six Classics are all history
oneLineZh: 清代史学理论家，以六经皆史和文史校雠理论著称。
oneLineEn: Qing history theorist known for 'the Six Classics are all history' and collation theory.

oneLineZh: 清代考据学者，以《考信录》辨析上古史传可信度。
oneLineEn: Qing evidential scholar who, in Records Examining Credibility, tested ancient historical transmission.

oneLineZh: 清代经学家、官员和学术组织者，乾嘉考据集大成者之一。
oneLineEn: Qing classicist, official, and academic organizer; a major synthesizer of Qian-Jia evidential learning.

oneLineZh: 清代经学家和数学家，以孟子学、易学和逻辑分析著称。
oneLineEn: Qing classicist and mathematician known for Mencius studies, Yijing learning, and logical analysis.

keywordsEn: On Enlightened Rulers and Good Ministers
oneLineZh: 晚清思想家和文学家，以经世改革、个体精神和制度批判著称。
oneLineEn: Late Qing thinker-writer known for statecraft reform, individual spirit, and institutional critique.

keywordsEn: Illustrated Treatise on the Maritime Kingdoms
oneLineZh: 晚清经世思想家，以《海国图志》提出师夷长技以制夷。
oneLineEn: Late Qing statecraft thinker; Maritime Kingdoms urged learning barbarian skills to control barbarians.

oneLineZh: 意向性概念的复兴者，以描述心理学连接亚里士多德、经院传统与胡塞尔现象学。
对象论创立者，主张非存在的对象亦有其所是，深刻影响指称理论与本体论争论。
符号形式哲学的创立者，把神话、语言与科学统一为人的符号化活动。
美国绝对唯心主义与共同体哲学代表，以「忠」为核心构造伦理学。
自然主义、怀疑论与美学的交界人物，以《理性的生命》和《存在的领域》立说。

names.zh: 弗朗西斯·赫伯特·布拉德利

oneLineZh: 英国绝对唯心主义代表，以关系的内在性论证成为罗素与摩尔反叛的靶心。
英国新黑格尔主义与新自由主义的源头人物，以伦理国家和积极自由重构自由概念。
古典功利主义的系统化者，《伦理学方法》为密尔之后的伦理学奠定技术化框架。
形式社会学与文化哲学代表，以互动形式和货币哲学剖析现代性经验。
现象学价值伦理学代表，以质料价值伦理学和人格理论回应康德的形式主义。
基督教存在主义代表，以「奥秘」与「问题」之分和希望现象学立说。

names.zh: 何塞·奥尔特加-伊-加塞特

oneLineZh: 生命理性与视角主义的倡导者，《大众的反叛》批判现代群众社会。
以《生命的悲剧意识》书写理性与信仰之间无法调和的冲突。
实际唯心主义的创立者，主张思维行动即唯一实在，因此与克罗齐分道扬镳。
历史哲学与问答逻辑代表，主张一切历史都是思想在当下的重演。
以实践知识对抗政治理性主义，为英国保守主义提供了哲学表达。
《心的概念》以「机器中的幽灵」批判笛卡尔二元论，奠定日常语言学派。
言语行为理论的源头，《如何以言行事》把语言从意义推向行动。

names.zh: 彼得·弗雷德里克·斯特劳森

oneLineZh: 以《个体》确立描述形而上学，重新接通康德与分析哲学。
意义理论与反实在论代表，以可断言性条件重解弗雷格。
「成为一只蝙蝠是什么感觉」的提出者，以主观视角挑战还原论。
《论暴力》以社会神话和革命工团主义构成马克思主义内部的异端。
新本体论代表，以实在的层次结构调和现象学与形而上学。
马堡新康德主义核心人物，把认识论推进到社会教育哲学。
西南学派创始人，以规律科学与个别科学之分奠定文化科学方法论。
以价值关联概念完善文化科学方法论，构成韦伯方法论的直接背景。
历史主义与宗教哲学代表，处理狄尔泰、韦伯与神学现代性的交汇。
《行动》以行动的内在逻辑通向超越，为法国天主教现代思想开路。
概念实用主义与模态逻辑代表，以严格蕴涵回应实质蕴涵悖论。
真理、概率、决策与经济学的早期枢纽，二十六岁早逝仍留下多重奠基性工作。
英国第一位女性哲学教授，以《有目的的思维》推广逻辑分析与公共说理。
心灵哲学、伦理学与形而上学的剑桥综合者，以细致分类和折衷立场著称。
《语言、真理与逻辑》把维也纳学派带入英语世界。
以「绿蓝」悖论重提归纳问题，并把符号系统理论推向艺术哲学。
澳大利亚唯物论代表，以共相实在论和心脑同一论构造形而上学系统。
心脑同一论与后果主义代表，主张一种彻底的科学实在论。
量化模态逻辑先驱，巴坎公式为后来的模态语义学铺路。
《心灵与世界》主张经验本身已是概念性的，重连分析哲学与黑格尔传统。
以关节炎思想实验确立心灵内容的社会外在论。
推论主义语义学代表，把意义奠基于给出与索取理由的推论实践。
改革宗认识论与模态本体论证代表，主张有神论信念可以是基础信念。
以贝叶斯概率论证有神论，代表英美自然神学的当代形态。
规定主义代表，主张道德判断兼具规定性与可普遍化性。
以小提琴家论证和电车难题重塑应用伦理学的案例传统。
赫尔馆创办者，把实用主义带入社会改革与和平运动。
哈莱姆文艺复兴的哲学阐释者，以价值多元主义论述文化差异。
以主我与客我之分和角色采择建立社会自我理论。
古典政治哲学的复兴者，以隐微写作解释重读古今之争。
以「恐惧的自由主义」和对残酷的优先关注重构自由主义。
《责任原理》为技术文明提出面向未来世代的伦理律令。
论证现代进步史观其实是基督教末世论的世俗化产物。
以政治宗教和秩序哲学诊断现代性，把灵知主义视作病根。
新托马斯主义代表，为世界人权宣言提供了哲学论证。
以主奴辩证法讲授《精神现象学》，塑造了整整一代法国思想家。
结构主义马克思主义代表，提出意识形态国家机器与认识论断裂。
以个体化理论和技术物的存在方式重构技术哲学。
生命现象学代表，主张生命在自身感发中直接显现。
捷克现象学家与七七宪章发言人，以照料灵魂论述历史性存在。
《马克思主义主要流派》作者，从修正主义转向对乌托邦的宗教式追问。

names.zh: 科尔内留斯·卡斯托里亚迪斯

oneLineZh: 以社会想象性建制和自治理论构成西方马克思主义的异端。
以概率、经济学与偶然性理论连接实证论与法国认识论传统。
约定论代表，主张几何公理既非经验也非先验，而是约定。
提出迪昂命题：假说无法孤立检验，为奎因的整体论开路。
以判断哲学和科学精神史成为法国认识论学院的枢纽。
《从封闭世界到无限宇宙》重写科学革命史，深刻影响库恩。
以认识论断裂和认识论障碍重构科学史，同时写物质想象的诗学。
以概念哲学对抗意识哲学，参加抵抗运动而被处决。
《正常与病态》以生命的规范性重写医学哲学，是福柯的直系导师。
以亲属结构和神话学分析奠定结构人类学。
以镜像阶段和「无意识如语言般构成」重读弗洛伊德。
以惯习、场域和文化资本构建社会实践理论。
《后现代状况》宣告元叙事的终结。
以拟像与超真实理论剖析消费社会的符号逻辑。
以第三者和寄生者的形象打通科学史与人文传统。
以模仿欲望和替罪羊机制解释暴力与神圣的起源。
以行动者网络理论把物一并纳入社会分析。
以权力的空位界定民主，并系统批判极权主义。
《存在与事件》以集合论建构本体论和事件性的真理观。
以感性的分配把政治与美学置于同一问题域。
以无用的共通体和共在存在论回应海德格尔与巴塔耶。
以《知识分子的鸦片》和历史哲学捍卫自由主义，与萨特长期论争。
以耗费、逾越和普遍经济概念探讨神圣与僭越。
以文学空间、中性与灾异书写探索语言的界限。

names.zh: 弗拉基米尔·扬凯列维奇

oneLineZh: 以「几乎无」和不可宽恕问题书写道德经验的细微处。
以存在（esse）为核心重释托马斯，推动中世纪哲学史研究。
人格主义运动创始人，创办《精神》杂志倡导位格与共同体。
启蒙旗手，宽容、理性与反教权论争，接洛克经验论并与卢梭构成同代张力。
oneLineEn: Enlightenment champion of tolerance, reason, and anti-clerical polemic; after Locke, in tension with Rousseau.

oneLineZh: 《百科全书》主编，连接启蒙知识工程、唯物论与美学批评。
oneLineEn: Encyclopédie editor linking Enlightenment knowledge projects, materialism, and aesthetic criticism.

oneLineZh: 《论法的精神》以分权与政体类型学成为现代政治哲学关键节点。
oneLineEn: Spirit of the Laws made separation of powers and regime typology a modern political-philosophy node.

oneLineZh: 感觉论把洛克经验论推向系统化，雕像譬喻成为认识论史线索。
oneLineEn: Sensationalism that systematized Locke; the statue analogy is a key epistemology clue.

oneLineZh: 进步史观与社会数学连接启蒙政治哲学和后来的实证主义叙事。
oneLineEn: Progressive history and social mathematics linking Enlightenment politics to later positivism.

oneLineZh: 《自然的体系》代表法国启蒙的彻底唯物论与决定论。
oneLineEn: System of Nature represents French Enlightenment thoroughgoing materialism and determinism.

oneLineZh: 感觉论伦理与功利主义前史，连接洛克经验论和边沁功利主义。
oneLineEn: Sensationalist ethics and utilitarian prehistory linking Locke's empiricism to Bentham.

oneLineZh: 《人是机器》将机械论推向人类身心解释，是启蒙唯物论极端形态。
oneLineEn: Man a Machine pushed mechanism to body-mind explanation; extreme Enlightenment materialism.

oneLineZh: 偶因论与“在上帝中看见万物”使笛卡尔主义进入神学形而上学争论。
oneLineEn: Occasionalism and 'seeing all things in God' moved Cartesianism into theological metaphysics.

oneLineZh: 复兴伊壁鸠鲁原子论，并在《沉思》诘难中成为笛卡尔同时代批评者。
oneLineEn: Reviver of Epicurean atomism and contemporary critic of Descartes in the Meditations objections.

oneLineZh: 《历史批判辞典》以怀疑论、宽容和神义论问题影响莱布尼茨。
oneLineEn: Historical and Critical Dictionary influenced Leibniz via skepticism, tolerance, and theodicy.

oneLineZh: 努力与意志的内在经验开启法国唯灵论，连接笛卡尔反思传统和柏格森。
oneLineEn: Inner experience of effort and will opened French spiritualism; links Descartes to Bergson.

oneLineZh: 折衷主义和法国学院哲学建制，吸收德国观念论与批判哲学。
oneLineEn: Eclecticism and French academic philosophy absorbing German idealism and critical philosophy.

oneLineZh: 新批判主义重写康德问题，并对威廉·詹姆斯的自由意志论产生影响。
oneLineEn: Neo-criticism rewrote Kant and influenced William James on free will.

oneLineZh: 《论习惯》影响柏格森，并通过亚里士多德研究连接法国唯灵论和古典形而上学。
oneLineEn: Of Habit influenced Bergson and linked French spiritualism to classical metaphysics via Aristotle.

oneLineZh: 以自然律偶然性批判严格决定论，连接法国科学哲学与唯灵论。
oneLineEn: Critiqued strict determinism via contingency of natural law; linked French science philosophy and spiritualism.

oneLineZh: 《梵经》的传统归属作者，吠檀多根本经和三大注家共同锚点。
oneLineEn: Traditional author of the Brahma Sūtras; Vedānta root text shared by the three major commentators.

oneLineZh: 《弥曼差经》的传统归属作者，前弥曼差的祭祀解释学由此立宗。
以《数论颂》系统化数论派二元论和三德理论。
oneLineEn: Systematized Sāṃkhya dualism and the three guṇas in the Sāṃkhya Kārikā.

oneLineZh: 《瑜伽经》的传统归属作者，瑜伽派八支修行论由此系统化。
《正理经》的传统归属作者，正理派逻辑与知识论源头。
oneLineEn: Traditional author of the Nyāya Sūtra; source of Nyāya logic and epistemology.

oneLineZh: 《胜论经》的传统归属作者，胜论派的原子论与范畴论由此立宗。
《句词论》作者，印度语言哲学与语法传统的关键节点。
oneLineEn: Author of Vākyapadīya; key node of Indian philosophy of language and grammar.

oneLineZh: 弥曼差知识论代表，以维护吠陀权威和批评佛教量论著称。
oneLineEn: Mīmāṃsā epistemologist who defended Vedic authority and criticized Buddhist pramāṇa theory.

oneLineZh: 正理派代表，系统论证神存在并回应佛教哲学批评。
oneLineEn: Nyāya figure who systematically argued for God's existence and answered Buddhist critics.

oneLineZh: 新正理派核心人物，以《真理宝珠》推进精密逻辑和知识论分析。
oneLineEn: Core Navya-Nyāya figure who, in Jewel of Truth, advanced precise logic and epistemology.

oneLineZh: 克什米尔湿婆派与印度美学代表，连接宗教形而上学和味论传统。
oneLineEn: Kashmir Śaiva and Indian aesthetics master linking religious metaphysics to the rasa tradition.

oneLineZh: 新吠檀多与印度现代宗教思想传播的代表人物。
oneLineEn: Neo-Vedānta figure and transmitter of modern Indian religious thought.

oneLineZh: 整体瑜伽与进化灵性思想代表，连接吠檀多、瑜伽和现代印度思想。
oneLineEn: Integral Yoga and evolutionary spirituality linking Vedānta, yoga, and modern Indian thought.

oneLineZh: 日本真言宗奠基者，连接唐代密教与日本佛教。
oneLineEn: Founder of Japanese Shingon who linked Tang esoteric Buddhism to Japan.

oneLineZh: 日本净土宗奠基者，以专修念佛重组净土传统。
oneLineEn: Founder of Japanese Pure Land Buddhism who reorganized the tradition around exclusive nembutsu.

oneLineZh: 日莲佛教奠基者，以法华经信仰和护国论形成独特日本佛教路线。
oneLineEn: Founder of Nichiren Buddhism via Lotus faith and national-protection discourse in Japan.

oneLineZh: 江户时期临济禅中兴人物，强化公案训练体系。
oneLineEn: Edo Rinzai Zen reviver who strengthened the kōan training system.

oneLineZh: 江户古学派代表，主张回到孔孟文本并批评朱子学。
oneLineEn: Edo Ancient Learning figure who returned to Confucius-Mencius texts and criticized Zhu Xi learning.

oneLineZh: 江户儒学代表，以古文辞学和礼乐制度论批评朱子学。
oneLineEn: Edo Confucian who criticized Zhu Xi learning via ancient rhetoric and ritual-music institutions.

oneLineZh: 日本国学代表，围绕古典文本和“物哀”重构审美与身份论述。
oneLineEn: Japanese kokugaku figure remaking aesthetics and identity around classics and mono no aware.

oneLineZh: 明治启蒙代表，以文明论和独立观念推动日本现代思想转型。
oneLineEn: Meiji Enlightenment leader who drove modern Japanese thought via civilization theory and independence.

oneLineZh: 以“粹”的美学和偶然性问题连接日本美学与欧陆哲学。
oneLineEn: Aesthetics of iki and contingency linking Japanese aesthetics to Continental philosophy.

oneLineZh: 京都学派核心人物，以种的逻辑和忏悔道形成独特哲学体系。
oneLineEn: Kyoto School core whose logic of species and philosophy as metanoetics form a distinctive system.

oneLineZh: 朝鲜佛教代表人物，以和诤思想统合不同佛教教义。
oneLineEn: Korean Buddhist figure uniting diverse doctrines via harmony of disputes (hwajaeng).

oneLineZh: 朝鲜禅宗关键人物，以顿悟渐修和曹溪传统重组朝鲜佛教。
oneLineEn: Key Korean Seon figure reorganizing Buddhism via sudden enlightenment/gradual cultivation and Jogye.

oneLineZh: 朝鲜儒学中气一元论代表，连接张载气论和退溪语境。
oneLineEn: Korean Confucian qi monist linking Zhang Zai's qi theory to the Toegye context.

oneLineZh: 朝鲜实学重要人物，连接退溪朱子学传统与社会经世问题。
oneLineEn: Key Korean silhak figure linking Toegye Zhu Xi learning to social statecraft problems.

oneLineZh: 朝鲜实学集大成者，重释经学并发展经世政治思想。
oneLineEn: Summative Korean silhak figure who reread the classics and developed statecraft political thought.

oneLineZh: 瑜伽行中观代表，入藏建桑耶寺，是印度佛教入藏的关键节点。
oneLineEn: Yogācāra-Madhyamaka figure who entered Tibet and founded Samye; key node of Indian Buddhism in Tibet.

oneLineZh: 桑耶论诤中渐门代表，以《修习次第》成为入藏佛教修道论节点。
oneLineEn: Gradualist side of the Samye debate; Bhāvanākrama is a key node of Indo-Tibetan path theory.

keywordsEn: Lamp for the Path to Enlightenment
oneLineZh: 噶当派关键人物，以《菩提道灯论》影响藏传道次第传统。
oneLineEn: Key Kadampa figure whose Lamp for the Path to Enlightenment shaped Tibetan lamrim.

oneLineZh: 噶举派瑜伽士，以道歌传统代表藏传修行文学和解脱叙事。
oneLineEn: Kagyu yogin whose songs represent Tibetan practice literature and liberation narrative.

oneLineZh: 达波噶举奠基者，融合噶当道次第和大手印传统。
oneLineEn: Founder of Dakpo Kagyu, fusing Kadampa lamrim with Mahāmudrā.

oneLineZh: 萨迦派系统家，以《量理宝藏论》推进藏传量论传统。
oneLineEn: Sakya systematizer who advanced Tibetan pramāṇa in Treasury of Reasoning.

oneLineZh: 宁玛大圆满系统家，以《七宝藏》等著作成为藏传形而上学和修行论核心节点。
oneLineEn: Nyingma Dzogchen systematizer; Seven Treasuries are core Tibetan metaphysics and practice theory.

keywordsEn: Great Treatise on the Stages of the Path
oneLineZh: 格鲁派创立者，以应成中观解释和道次第体系影响藏传佛教。
oneLineEn: Gelug founder whose Prāsaṅgika Madhyamaka and lamrim shaped Tibetan Buddhism.

oneLineZh: 觉囊派系统家，以他空见构成藏传中观解释的重要分歧。
oneLineEn: Jonang systematizer whose other-emptiness (zhentong) marks a major Tibetan Madhyamaka divide.

oneLineZh: 萨迦派中观系统家，以对宗喀巴解释的批评成为藏传中观内部重要节点。
oneLineEn: Sakya Madhyamaka systematizer whose critique of Tsongkhapa is a major internal Tibetan node.

oneLineZh: 藏传佛教史家和大藏经编定关键人物。
oneLineEn: Tibetan Buddhist historian and key figure in Kangyur/Tengyur redaction.

oneLineZh: 利美运动核心人物，以《知识总汇》等整合藏传多传统。
oneLineEn: Rimé core figure integrating multiple Tibetan traditions in the Treasury of Knowledge and Five Treasuries.

oneLineZh: 宁玛利美代表人物，以中观和量论注疏成为近现代藏传系统家。
oneLineEn: Nyingma Rimé figure whose Madhyamaka and pramāṇa commentaries shape modern Tibetan systematics.

oneLineZh: 格鲁派当代领袖，以中观解释、伦理和科学对话进入全球哲学语境。
oneLineEn: Contemporary Gelug leader bringing Madhyamaka, ethics, and science dialogue into global philosophy.

oneLineZh: 早期穆尔太齐赖派奠基者，以理性神学、自由意志和“介于两种地位之间”问题开启 kalam 传统分歧。
oneLineEn: Early Muʿtazilī founder opening kalām splits via rational theology, free will, and intermediate position.

oneLineZh: 艾什尔里派创立者，在反穆尔太齐赖与维护逊尼教义之间重塑理性神学。
oneLineEn: Founder of Ashʿarism who reshaped rational theology between anti-Muʿtazilism and Sunni doctrine.

oneLineZh: 马图里迪派奠基者，在哈乃斐语境中发展关于理性、启示和人类责任的逊尼教义学。
oneLineEn: Founder of Māturīdism; Sunni theology of reason, revelation, and responsibility in a Ḥanafī frame.

oneLineZh: 艾什尔里派系统化者，以教义论证、原子论时间观和《古兰经》不可模仿性论证著称。
oneLineEn: Ashʿarī systematizer known for doctrinal proofs, atomistic time, and Qurʾānic inimitability.

oneLineZh: “两圣地伊玛目”，安萨里之师，在艾什尔里教义学和法学原理中强化证明结构。
oneLineEn: Imām al-Ḥaramayn, teacher of al-Ghazālī; strengthened demonstration in Ashʿarī theology and uṣūl.

oneLineZh: 集大成教义学家和哲学神学家，在吸收并批判伊本·西那之后重塑后期 kalam 的问题格局。
oneLineEn: Summative theologian-philosopher who reshaped later kalām after absorbing and critiquing Ibn Sīnā.

names.en: Abū Bakr Muḥammad ibn Zakariyyāʾ al-Rāzī
names.native: أبو بكر محمد بن زكريا الرازي

oneLineZh: 医师—哲学家和自由思想家，以理性自然主义、医学百科和对宗教权威的激进批判著称。
oneLineEn: Physician-philosopher and freethinker known for rational naturalism and critique of religious authority.

oneLineZh: 伊斯兰伦理学系统家，以《性理之净化》把希腊德性伦理转化为灵魂训练和品格教育方案。
oneLineEn: Islamic ethics systematizer who, in Refinement of Character, turned Greek virtue ethics into soul training.

oneLineZh: 安达卢斯哲学家，以《孤独者之治理》讨论哲人如何在不完善城邦中保存理智完善。
oneLineEn: Andalusian philosopher who, in Governance of the Solitary, asked how sages keep perfection in imperfect cities.

oneLineZh: 安达卢斯哲学家，以《哈义·本·叶格赞》叙述孤岛理性如何从自然观察上升到形而上学与宗教真理。
oneLineEn: Andalusian author of Ḥayy ibn Yaqẓān, in which island reason rises from nature to metaphysics and religion.

oneLineZh: 安达卢斯查希里派思想家，兼具法学、逻辑、宗教论辩和爱情文学写作。
oneLineEn: Andalusian Ẓāhirī thinker combining law, logic, religious polemic, and love literature.

oneLineZh: 哲学家、伦理学家和天文学家，在后伊本·西那哲学、什叶神学和数学天文学之间建立关键连接。
oneLineEn: Philosopher, ethicist, and astronomer linking post-Avicennan philosophy, Shīʿī theology, and math astronomy.

oneLineZh: 早期苏非圣徒形象，以不为天堂地狱而只为真主的纯粹神爱成为苏非爱的经典源头。
oneLineEn: Early Sufi saint whose pure divine love—not for paradise or hell—became classic source of Sufi love.

oneLineZh: 巴格达苏非“清醒派”核心人物，以在神秘体验与教法边界之间保持纪律化表达著称。
oneLineEn: Core of Baghdad's sober Sufism; disciplined expression between mystical experience and law.

oneLineZh: 以“我即真理”形象和殉道结局成为苏非神秘合一、言说边界与宗教权威冲突的核心节点。
oneLineEn: Sufi of 'I am the Truth' and martyrdom; node of mystical union and conflict with religious authority.

oneLineZh: 波斯苏非诗人与神秘思想家，以《玛斯纳维》将爱、合一和灵魂转化写成影响深远的诗性哲学。
oneLineEn: Persian Sufi poet-mystic whose Mathnawī made love, union, and soul transformation poetic philosophy.

oneLineZh: 伊斯玛仪派诗人和思想家，以波斯语哲学诗文表达宇宙论、启示解释和灵魂归返问题。
oneLineEn: Ismāʿīlī poet-thinker whose Persian philosophical verse treats cosmology, revelation, and soul's return.

oneLineZh: 罕百里派法学家和神学批判者，以反哲学、反kalam、反苏非一元论和政治神学影响后世。
oneLineEn: Ḥanbalī jurist-critic opposing philosophy, kalām, and Sufi monism; shaped later political theology.

oneLineZh: 伊斯法罕学派核心人物和萨德拉之师，以时间、永恒和创生问题构成萨法维哲学的重要节点。
oneLineEn: Isfahan School core and Mullā Ṣadrā's teacher; time, eternity, and creation in Safavid philosophy.

oneLineZh: 当代什叶哲学家和经注家，以萨德拉传统、哲学认识论和《古兰经》诠释连接现代伊朗思想。
oneLineEn: Contemporary Shīʿī philosopher-exegete linking Ṣadrian tradition and Qurʾānic commentary to modern Iran.

oneLineZh: 泛伊斯兰政治活动家和现代主义先声，以反殖民、宗教改革和穆斯林公共政治动员影响近现代伊斯兰思想。
oneLineEn: Pan-Islamic activist and early modernist shaping anti-colonial, reformist Muslim public politics.

oneLineZh: 埃及现代主义改革者，以宗教教育、法学改革和理性化诠释推动伊斯兰与现代社会的协调。
oneLineEn: Egyptian modernist reformer coordinating Islam and modern society via education, law, and rational exegesis.

oneLineZh: 新现代主义伊斯兰思想家，以“双重运动”诠释学和古兰经伦理重构现代改革方法。
oneLineEn: Neo-modernist Islamic thinker whose double-movement hermeneutics remade modern Qurʾānic ethical reform.

oneLineZh: 当代伊斯兰传统学派思想家，以伊斯兰科学、形而上学和灵性传统批判现代世俗化知识观。
oneLineEn: Islamic traditionalist critiquing secular modern knowledge via Islamic science, metaphysics, and spirituality.

oneLineZh: 以希腊哲学范畴解释托拉，是犹太哲学古代谱系的关键起点。
oneLineEn: Interpreted Torah with Greek categories; key starting point of ancient Jewish philosophy.

oneLineZh: 早期中世纪犹太新柏拉图主义者，将阿拉伯哲学与犹太思想相接。
oneLineEn: Early medieval Jewish Neoplatonist linking Arabic philosophy to Jewish thought.

oneLineZh: 以《生命之源》提出新柏拉图主义形而上学，在拉丁经院传统中以 Avicebron 著称。
oneLineEn: In Fons Vitae set out Neoplatonic metaphysics; known in Latin scholasticism as Avicebron.

oneLineZh: 《心之义务》作者，把内在虔敬、伦理修养与犹太律法生活结合起来。
oneLineEn: Author of Duties of the Heart; joined inner piety and ethical discipline to Jewish legal life.

oneLineZh: 《库萨里》作者，以对话体为犹太启示与历史共同体辩护。
oneLineEn: Author of the Kuzari; dialogical defense of Jewish revelation and historical community.

oneLineZh: 《崇高信仰》作者，是迈蒙尼德之前犹太亚里士多德主义的重要节点。
oneLineEn: Author of The Exalted Faith; a key pre-Maimonidean node of Jewish Aristotelianism.

oneLineZh: 《主的战争》作者，将亚里士多德—阿威罗伊传统推进到犹太哲学内部。
oneLineEn: Author of The Wars of the Lord who advanced Aristotelian-Averroist tradition within Jewish philosophy.

oneLineZh: 《主之光》作者，系统批判中世纪亚里士多德主义并重估神爱与无限性。
oneLineEn: Author of Light of the Lord; critiqued medieval Aristotelianism and revalued divine love and infinity.

oneLineZh: 《信条书》作者，重整犹太教义原则与信仰分类。
oneLineEn: Author of Book of Principles; reorganized Jewish doctrinal principles and faith classification.

oneLineZh: 拉姆班以释经、哈拉卡与早期卡巴拉参与迈蒙尼德之争。
oneLineEn: Ramban joined exegesis, halakhah, and early Kabbalah in the Maimonidean controversies.

oneLineZh: 《光辉之书》传播与作者问题的核心人物，是中世纪卡巴拉谱系关键节点。
oneLineEn: Key figure in Zohar transmission and authorship; medieval Kabbalah lineage node.

oneLineZh: 先知/迷狂卡巴拉代表，以字母组合、神名默想和预言经验理论著称。
oneLineEn: Prophetic/ecstatic Kabbalist known for letter combination, divine-name meditation, and prophecy theory.

oneLineZh: 卢里亚卡巴拉核心人物，以收缩、器皿破碎和修复理论重塑近世犹太神秘主义。
oneLineEn: Core Lurianic Kabbalist remaking early modern Jewish mysticism via contraction, shattering, and repair.

oneLineZh: 哈西德派创始人物，以灵性喜乐、虔敬生活和神圣临在感影响东欧犹太教。
oneLineEn: Hasidic founder whose spiritual joy, piety, and sense of divine presence shaped East European Judaism.

oneLineZh: 哈巴德创始人，《坦尼亚》作者，将哈西德灵修组织为智性化神学体系。
oneLineEn: Chabad founder and Tanya author who organized Hasidic spirituality as intellectualized theology.

oneLineZh: 犹太启蒙关键人物，以《耶路撒冷》讨论宗教权力、宽容与犹太公民身份。
oneLineEn: Haskalah hub; Jerusalem treats religious power, tolerance, and Jewish civic status.

oneLineZh: 现代卡巴拉研究奠基者，以历史—文献方法重塑犹太神秘主义研究。
oneLineEn: Founder of modern Kabbalah studies who remade Jewish mysticism with historical-philological method.

names.zh: 亚伯拉罕·约书亚·赫舍尔

oneLineZh: 20世纪犹太神学家，以敬畏、先知伦理与宗教经验论连接灵修和公共正义。
oneLineEn: Twentieth-century Jewish theologian joining awe, prophetic ethics, and experience to justice.

oneLineZh: 现代正统犹太思想代表，以哈拉哈主体、创造性人格和信仰孤独构造宗教哲学。
oneLineEn: Modern Orthodox thought via Halakhic man, creative personality, and loneliness of faith.

oneLineZh: 重建主义犹太教奠基者，将犹太教解释为演化中的宗教文明。
oneLineEn: Founder of Reconstructionist Judaism who read Judaism as an evolving religious civilization.

oneLineZh: 以色列犹太思想家，强调信仰即服从诫命，并以尖锐公共批评著称。
oneLineEn: Israeli Jewish thinker holding faith as obedience to commandments, with sharp public criticism.

names.zh: 巴托洛梅·德·拉斯·卡萨斯

oneLineZh: 殖民早期为美洲原住民理性与权利辩护的多明我会思想家。
oneLineEn: Dominican defender of Indigenous reason and rights in early colonial America.

oneLineZh: 委内瑞拉—智利思想家，以法律、教育和语言工程参与独立后国家建构。
oneLineEn: Venezuelan-Chilean thinker who shaped post-independence state-building via law, education, and language.

oneLineZh: 委内瑞拉教育思想家，以美洲共和国和大众教育方案回应独立后的社会重建。
oneLineEn: Venezuelan educator answering post-independence rebuilding with American republics and popular education.

oneLineZh: 阿根廷自由主义与宪政思想家，提出国家组织和美洲哲学的现实任务。
oneLineEn: Argentine liberal and constitutional thinker who set nation-building as American philosophy's task.

oneLineZh: 阿根廷思想家，《法昆多》以文明/野蛮框架塑造19世纪拉美现代化论述。
oneLineEn: Argentine thinker; Facundo framed Latin American modernization as civilization vs. barbarism.

names.zh: 欧亨尼奥·玛丽亚·德·奥斯托斯

oneLineZh: 波多黎各教育家与伦理思想家，以社会伦理和安的列斯解放方案连接实证主义与反殖民政治。
oneLineEn: Puerto Rican educator-ethicist linking social ethics and Antillean liberation to positivism and anti-colonialism.

oneLineZh: 墨西哥孔德式实证主义代表，把教育制度改革作为社会秩序重建工具。
oneLineEn: Mexican Comtean positivist who used educational reform as a tool of social-order reconstruction.

oneLineZh: 古巴独立思想家，《我们的美洲》以美洲主体性回应殖民与帝国秩序。
oneLineEn: Cuban independence thinker; Our America answered empire with American subjectivity.

oneLineZh: 乌拉圭思想家，《爱丽尔》以审美—伦理教育塑造拉美精神身份论。
oneLineEn: Uruguayan thinker whose Ariel shaped Latin American spiritual identity via aesthetic-ethical education.

oneLineZh: 墨西哥反实证主义思想家，以生命、伦理和人格问题反拨孔德式知识秩序。
oneLineEn: Mexican anti-positivist who countered Comtean order with life, ethics, and personhood.

oneLineZh: 墨西哥思想家与教育家，《宇宙种族》以混血宇宙论重写美洲身份。
oneLineEn: Mexican thinker-educator; Cosmic Race rewrote American identity via mestizo cosmology.

oneLineZh: 阿根廷反实证主义思想家，以创造性自由和价值问题重构哲学任务。
oneLineEn: Argentine anti-positivist who reframed philosophy around creative freedom and value.

keywordsEn: Profile of Man and Culture in Mexico
oneLineZh: 墨西哥身份哲学代表，《墨西哥人的轮廓》分析民族性格与文化自我认识。
oneLineEn: Mexican identity philosophy; Profile of Man and Culture analyzes national character and self-knowledge.

oneLineZh: 阿根廷哲学家，推动专业哲学制度化并发展人格与精神生命理论。
oneLineEn: Argentine philosopher who professionalized academic philosophy and developed personhood and spiritual life theory.

oneLineZh: 阿根廷价值论哲学家，以价值结构和自我理论进入20世纪拉美学院哲学谱系。
oneLineEn: Argentine value theorist whose structure of value and self entered Latin American academic philosophy.

names.zh: 奥古斯托·萨拉萨尔·邦迪

keywordsEn: Is There a Philosophy of Our America?
oneLineZh: 秘鲁哲学家，以拉美哲学真实性问题开启与 Zea 的经典争论。
oneLineEn: Peruvian philosopher who opened the classic debate with Zea on Latin American philosophical authenticity.

names.zh: 伊格纳西奥·埃拉库里亚

oneLineZh: 萨尔瓦多耶稣会哲学家，以历史现实概念连接解放哲学、神学与政治实践。
oneLineEn: Salvadoran Jesuit whose historical reality joined liberation philosophy, theology, and politics.

oneLineZh: 秘鲁神学家，《解放神学》奠定拉美解放神学的问题框架。
oneLineEn: Peruvian theologian whose Liberation Theology framed Latin American liberation theology.

oneLineZh: 阿根廷思想家，以美洲在场、原住民世界和大众文化批判欧洲存在论。
oneLineEn: Argentine thinker critiquing European ontology via American presence, Indigenous worlds, and popular culture.

oneLineZh: 秘鲁社会理论家，提出‘权力的殖民性’并影响去殖民理论。
oneLineEn: Peruvian social theorist of the 'coloniality of power' who shaped decolonial theory.

oneLineZh: 阿根廷裔女性主义哲学家，以性别殖民性理论推进去殖民女性主义。
oneLineEn: Argentine-born feminist whose coloniality of gender advanced decolonial feminism.

oneLineZh: 墨西哥诗人兼思想家，以《孤独的迷宫》分析墨西哥身份、孤独与现代性。
oneLineEn: Mexican poet-thinker who, in Labyrinth of Solitude, analyzed Mexican identity, solitude, and modernity.

names.zh: 大巴西尔（该撒利亚的巴西尔）

oneLineZh: 卡帕多西亚三杰之一，以三一神学、创世解释和修道规章构成希腊教父传统核心。
oneLineEn: One of the Cappadocian Fathers; shaped Greek patristics via Trinitarian theology, creation exegesis, and monastic rules.

oneLineZh: 卡帕多西亚三杰之一，以《神学演讲五篇》奠定东正教三一神学表达。
oneLineEn: One of the Cappadocian Fathers; his Five Theological Orations fixed Eastern Orthodox Trinitarian expression.

oneLineZh: 卡帕多西亚三杰之一，以神秘神学、无限进展和人论深化希腊教父传统。
oneLineEn: One of the Cappadocian Fathers; deepened Greek patristics via mystical theology, epektasis, and anthropology.

names.zh: 伪狄奥尼修斯（亚略巴古的丢尼修）

oneLineZh: 约500年成书的托名作者传统，以否定神学、神圣名称和等级论深刻影响东方与拉丁中世纪。
oneLineEn: Pseudepigraphic (~500) negative theology, Divine Names, and hierarchy shaping Eastern and Latin medieval thought.

oneLineZh: 拜占庭神学综合者，以《难题集》、两种意志论和宇宙-基督神学承接希腊教父传统。
oneLineEn: Byzantine theological synthesizer taking up Greek patristics via the Ambigua, dyothelitism, and cosmic Christology.

keywordsEn: Exact Exposition of the Orthodox Faith
oneLineZh: 拜占庭教义系统化者，以《知识的源泉》和圣像辩护连接亚里士多德逻辑与东正教神学。
oneLineEn: Byzantine doctrine systemizer linking Aristotelian logic and Orthodoxy via Fountain of Knowledge and icon defense.

oneLineZh: 拜占庭神秘主义思想家，以神圣之光的亲证经验和灵性知识影响后来的静修传统。
oneLineEn: Byzantine mystic whose divine-light experience and spiritual knowledge shaped later hesychasm.

oneLineZh: 拜占庭博学者和哲学家，以柏拉图主义复兴、宫廷政治观察和百科式学问连接古典与中世纪希腊传统。
oneLineEn: Byzantine polymath joining classical and medieval Greek thought via Platonic revival, court notes, and encyclopedism.

keywordsEn: Triads in Defense of the Holy Hesychasts
oneLineZh: 晚期拜占庭静修主义神学家，以本质/能质之分和《为静修者辩护》组织东正教神秘经验论证。
oneLineEn: Late Byzantine hesychast who framed Orthodox mystical experience via essence/energies distinction and the Triads.

oneLineZh: 晚期拜占庭柏拉图主义者，以《法律篇》和佛罗伦萨大公会议影响意大利文艺复兴的古典哲学复兴。
oneLineEn: Late Byzantine Platonist whose Book of Laws and Florence role shaped the Italian Renaissance classical revival.

names.zh: 琐罗亚斯德（查拉图斯特拉）

life.display: 约前1000（断代争议，另有前600等说）

oneLineZh: 古伊朗先知与祆教传统核心人物，以善恶抉择、真理秩序和末世审判构成前伊斯兰波斯思想源头。
oneLineEn: Ancient Iranian prophet of Zoroastrianism; good-evil choice, asha, and last judgment source pre-Islamic Persian thought.

oneLineZh: 萨珊时期摩尼教创立者，以亲撰经典组织光暗二元宇宙论、救赎论与禁欲伦理。
oneLineEn: Sasanian founder of Manichaeism; cast light-dark dualism, soteriology, and ascetic ethics in self-authored scriptures.

oneLineZh: 19世纪俄国思想家，《哲学书简》引发关于俄国历史使命与文明道路的论争。
oneLineEn: 19th-c. Russian thinker whose Philosophical Letters sparked debate on Russia's historical mission and path.

oneLineZh: 斯拉夫派核心理论家，以 sobornost 组织自由、共同体和东正教传统的思想口径。
oneLineEn: Core Slavophile theorist who framed freedom, community, and Orthodox tradition through sobornost.

oneLineZh: 斯拉夫派共同奠基者之一，以整全知识和东正教传统反思西欧理性主义。
oneLineEn: Co-founder of Slavophilism; integral knowledge and Orthodoxy against West European rationalism.

oneLineZh: 俄国西化派与流亡思想家，以个人自由、农民社会主义和俄国现代化问题著称。
oneLineEn: Russian Westernizer and exile thinker known for personal freedom, peasant socialism, and Russia's modernization problem.

keywordsZh: 国家制度与无政府状态
oneLineZh: 俄国无政府主义代表人物，以自由、国家批判和集体主义政治理论著称。
oneLineEn: Leading Russian anarchist known for freedom, critique of the state, and collectivist political theory.

oneLineZh: 俄国唯物主义与社会思想代表，以理性利己、现实美学和《怎么办？》影响19世纪激进传统。
oneLineEn: Russian materialist whose rational egoism, aesthetics of reality, and What Is to Be Done? shaped 19th-c. radicalism.

oneLineZh: 俄国无政府共产主义思想家，以《互助论》把合作、进化与自由共同体组织为政治伦理。
oneLineEn: Russian anarchist communist who, in Mutual Aid, cast cooperation, evolution, and free community as political ethics.

oneLineZh: 以小说承载宗教、自由、恶与救赎问题的俄国思想家型作家。
oneLineEn: Russian novelist-thinker who carried religion, freedom, evil, and redemption in literary form.

keywordsEn: The Kingdom of God Is Within You
oneLineZh: 以基督教伦理、非暴力和良心批判组织社会思想的俄国作家思想家。
oneLineEn: Russian writer-thinker organizing social thought around Christian ethics, nonviolence, and conscience critique.

oneLineZh: 俄国宗教哲学枢纽人物，以全统一、神人类、索菲亚学和善的证明影响白银时代。
oneLineEn: Hub of Russian religious philosophy; all-unity, Godmanhood, sophiology, and the Good shaped the Silver Age.

oneLineZh: 俄国宇宙主义先驱，以《共同事业的哲学》把人类联合、科学与复活论联结起来。
oneLineEn: Russian cosmism pioneer who, in Philosophy of the Common Task, joined human unity, science, and resurrection.

oneLineZh: 俄国宗教存在主义思想家，以《雅典与耶路撒冷》对抗理性必然性与信仰自由。
oneLineEn: Russian religious existentialist who, in Athens and Jerusalem, opposed rational necessity to freedom of faith.

oneLineZh: 白银时代宗教哲学家，以自由、人格、创造和反奴役问题为核心。
oneLineEn: Silver Age religious philosopher centered on freedom, personhood, creativity, and resistance to slavery.

keywordsZh: 从马克思主义转向宗教
oneLineZh: 白银时代宗教哲学家，早年接收马克思主义，后转向索菲亚学和神人类宗教哲学。
oneLineEn: Silver Age religious philosopher who moved from Marxism to sophiology and Godmanhood philosophy of religion.

keywordsEn: The Pillar and Ground of the Truth
oneLineZh: 白银时代神学家和哲学家，以《真理的柱石与根基》连接东正教、知识论和象征思想。
oneLineEn: Silver Age theologian-philosopher linking Orthodoxy, epistemology, and symbol in The Pillar and Ground of the Truth.

oneLineZh: 俄国宗教哲学家，以全一、不可测度者和直觉主义知识论连接形而上学与社会哲学。
oneLineEn: Russian religious philosopher joining metaphysics and social thought via all-unity, the Unfathomable, and intuitionism.

oneLineZh: 上座部巴利注疏传统的核心系统家，以《清净道论》综合戒定慧、阿毗达磨和解脱道路。
oneLineEn: Core systematizer of Theravada Pali commentary; Visuddhimagga unites sila-samadhi-panna, Abhidhamma, and the path.

oneLineZh: 上座部巴利注疏家，传统上与《胜义灯疏》系列小部注疏相连，断代约6—7世纪但不确。
oneLineEn: Theravāda Pali commentator linked to Paramatthadīpanī Khuddaka commentaries (ca. 6th–7th c., uncertain).

oneLineZh: 缅甸上座部阿毗达磨与内观复兴代表，以通俗手册推动教理学习和修行普及。
oneLineEn: Burmese Theravada Abhidhamma and vipassana revivalist who popularized doctrine and practice via plain manuals.

oneLineZh: 缅甸内观体系代表人物，以念处实践和马哈希方法影响现代全球上座部禅修。
oneLineEn: Leading Burmese vipassana teacher whose satipatthana practice and Mahasi method shaped global Theravada meditation.

oneLineZh: 泰国现代佛教思想家，以缘起重释、观呼吸修行和“法的社会主义”连接佛教改革与政治伦理。
oneLineEn: Modern Thai Buddhist thinker linking reform and politics via dependent origination, anapanasati, and Dhammic socialism.

oneLineZh: 陈朝帝王-禅师，以《课虚录》奠定越南中世禅学思想表达。
oneLineEn: Trần emperor-Zen master whose Lessons on Emptiness grounded medieval Vietnamese Zen.

keywordsEn: Fu on Dwelling in Dust and Delighting in the Way
oneLineZh: 陈朝帝王-禅师和竹林禅派开创者，统合越南诸禅派并留下禅诗文传统。
oneLineEn: Trần emperor-Zen master who founded Trúc Lâm, uniting Vietnamese Zen lines and a poetic tradition.

keywordsEn: Categorized Sayings of the Cloud Terrace
oneLineZh: 越南早期近世儒学与百科传统代表，以《芸台类语》承接宋明理学和博物知识体系。
oneLineEn: Early modern Vietnamese Confucian-encyclopedist joining Neo-Confucianism and natural knowledge in Categorized Sayings.
